notes.title: [Patch] Demo Patch 1 - 2025.08.27
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646989/999c8e5fe25437ebe0f4a6e2805a29275e3d6e17.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We hope you've been enjoying the Lumines Arise Demo. Be sure to play before the demo period ends on September 3, 2025, at 11:59 pm local time. We have just released the first patch to the Demo, and here’s what it addresses:[/p][h3]DEMO PATCH 1 - 2025.08.27[/h3][p]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/p][list][*][p]\[ALL] Fixed a bug that caused a connection error right before a Burst Battle match.[/p][/*][*][p]\[ALL] Fixed an issue where a login error could appear when starting up the game.[/p][/*][*][p]\[ALL] Text localization updates for Chinese. 修复部分中文本地化问题[/p][/*][/list][p]If you run into problems running or playing the Demo, please check the Support page of the [url="https://lumines.game"]lumines.game[/url] website or [url="https://enhance-experience.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new"]file a support ticket on Zendesk.[/url][/p][p][/p]
